title: 404: NO WAY OUT
design_note: 88 main missions replace the earlier 34-mission target while preserving the original first 34 mission identities and expanding the campaign.

missions.title: First Night
missions.brief: Meet Darius and establish the first lead.
missions.win_condition: Reach the safehouse and complete the introductory investigation.

missions.title: The First Account
missions.brief: Open the first financial trail.
missions.win_condition: Create a bank account and record the first suspicious transaction.

missions.title: Three Names
missions.brief: Learn that the investigation has more than one side.
missions.win_condition: Identify three connected names without losing the evidence.

missions.title: The Call
missions.brief: A call changes the direction of the investigation.
missions.win_condition: Answer the call and reach the meeting point alive.

missions.title: Veyron Central
missions.brief: Enter the city's central district and map the new territory.
missions.win_condition: Visit the marked Central locations and return safely.

missions.title: North Hills, Quiet Money
missions.brief: Follow a money trail into North Hills.
missions.win_condition: Photograph or record the target exchange and leave undetected.

missions.title: Iron District
missions.brief: Meet the people who keep the city's machines moving.
missions.win_condition: Reach Reed Workshop and secure Malik's cooperation.

missions.title: The Port Doesn't Sleep
missions.brief: Investigate Port traffic after dark.
missions.win_condition: Inspect the designated container and escape the port.

missions.title: People Remember
missions.brief: Test how much Veyron's residents notice.
missions.win_condition: Complete three social interactions without causing a police response.

missions.title: Amara's Rule
missions.brief: Learn Amara's information-gathering approach.
missions.win_condition: Collect three separate pieces of information and connect them.

missions.title: The Witness
missions.brief: Find a witness before someone else does.
missions.win_condition: Locate the witness and convince them to speak.

missions.title: No One Saw Anything
missions.brief: Protect a witness without exposing the team.
missions.win_condition: Move the witness to safety and avoid identification.

missions.title: Workshop Wheels
missions.brief: Get a reliable vehicle.
missions.win_condition: Acquire and store a usable vehicle at the workshop.

missions.title: Bad Tire, Worse Timing
missions.brief: Deal with a vehicle failure during a job.
missions.win_condition: Repair or replace the damaged tire and reach the destination.

missions.title: Night Run
missions.brief: Move evidence across Veyron under pressure.
missions.win_condition: Deliver the package before the timer expires.

missions.title: The Driver
missions.brief: Identify a driver linked to the network.
missions.win_condition: Follow the target without losing them.

missions.title: A Witness Called It In
missions.brief: See the witness system become a real threat.
missions.win_condition: Resolve the incident and escape the active search.

missions.title: Heat
missions.brief: Survive an escalating police response.
missions.win_condition: Lose the pursuit and reach a safe location.

missions.title: The Warehouse Job
missions.brief: Retrieve a hidden ledger.
missions.win_condition: Secure the ledger and escape with it intact.

missions.title: The Cost of Being Seen
missions.brief: Deal with the consequences of exposure.
missions.win_condition: Lower the wanted level and recover the lost evidence.

missions.title: Three Angles
missions.brief: Use all three protagonists to solve one problem.
missions.win_condition: Complete the Darius, Malik and Amara objectives.

missions.title: False Delivery
missions.brief: Use a decoy to redirect the network.
missions.win_condition: Complete the delivery without exposing the real package.

missions.title: The Long Chase
missions.brief: Keep a fleeing target in sight.
missions.win_condition: Finish the chase with the target identified.

missions.title: A Door That Wasn't There
missions.brief: Find a hidden entrance.
missions.win_condition: Discover the concealed location and retrieve the clue.

missions.title: The Empty Office
missions.brief: Search an abandoned office before evidence disappears.
missions.win_condition: Recover the file and leave before the search closes in.

missions.title: First Investment
missions.brief: Turn clean money into a legitimate foothold.
missions.win_condition: Complete the first investment and record its return.

missions.title: Safehouse
missions.brief: Secure a place the team can control.
missions.win_condition: Acquire or unlock the safehouse and store a vehicle.

missions.title: Pressure on the Books
missions.brief: Trace suspicious accounting.
missions.win_condition: Find the three accounting anomalies and link them.

missions.title: The Brother's Trail
missions.brief: Follow the strongest lead about Darius's brother.
missions.win_condition: Recover the next location clue.

missions.title: They Found Me
missions.brief: Survive a coordinated attack.
missions.win_condition: Escape the attack and preserve the evidence.

missions.brief: Discover what the 404 operation actually represents.
missions.win_condition: Assemble the required evidence chain.

missions.title: The Choice
missions.brief: Choose who receives the truth.
missions.win_condition: Commit to an ending path and complete its objective.

missions.title: No Way Out
missions.brief: Execute the final operation.
missions.win_condition: Complete the chosen operation and survive.

missions.title: After 404
missions.brief: Live with the consequences.
missions.win_condition: Complete the epilogue conditions for the chosen ending.

missions.title: Market Signals
missions.brief: Track a coded exchange through East Market.
missions.win_condition: Identify the buyer, seller and signal without losing the trail.

missions.title: Rain on Central
missions.brief: Use bad weather to observe a protected meeting.
missions.win_condition: Record the meeting and leave the district.

missions.title: Hilltop Contact
missions.brief: Meet a reluctant contact in North Hills.
missions.win_condition: Gain the contact's cooperation and obtain the address.

missions.title: Port Manifest
missions.brief: Compare a physical shipment with its manifest.
missions.win_condition: Find the mismatch and photograph the relevant page.

missions.title: Airport Window
missions.brief: Follow a passenger through the airport network.
missions.win_condition: Identify the passenger's destination.

missions.title: Island Rumor
missions.brief: Verify the first rumor about Blackwater Island.
missions.win_condition: Confirm the rumor and return with proof.

missions.title: The Regulars
missions.brief: Learn who spends every evening at the same café.
missions.win_condition: Identify three regulars and one useful connection.

missions.title: Family Business
missions.brief: Help a resident with a local problem.
missions.win_condition: Resolve the problem without escalating conflict.

missions.title: Bad Reputation
missions.brief: Repair Malik's standing with a neighborhood contact.
missions.win_condition: Raise the contact's trust enough to gain access.

missions.title: Amara's Memory
missions.brief: Use a remembered detail to reopen a closed lead.
missions.win_condition: Find the remembered location and recover the clue.

missions.title: Rumor Chain
missions.brief: Follow a rumor across three NPCs.
missions.win_condition: Reach the source without breaking the chain.

missions.title: The Second Witness
missions.brief: Find someone who contradicts the first witness.
missions.win_condition: Interview both and determine the reliable lead.

missions.title: Traffic Jam
missions.brief: Cross the city while traffic is gridlocked.
missions.win_condition: Reach the destination before the convoy leaves.

missions.title: Four Flats
missions.brief: Recover a vehicle with multiple damaged tires.
missions.win_condition: Repair all four tires and return it.

missions.title: Workshop Upgrade
missions.brief: Improve the team's vehicle capabilities.
missions.win_condition: Complete the workshop upgrade and test the vehicle.

missions.title: Boat Run
missions.brief: Move an item through the coastal route.
missions.win_condition: Reach the dock and deliver the item without sinking.

missions.title: Emergency Lane
missions.brief: Get through traffic behind an emergency response.
missions.win_condition: Stay with the route and reach the destination.

missions.title: The Stolen Car
missions.brief: Recover a stolen vehicle using its trail.
missions.win_condition: Find the vehicle and return it intact.

missions.title: Street Fight
missions.brief: Defend a contact from an assault.
missions.win_condition: Protect the contact and survive the encounter.

missions.title: First Pursuit
missions.brief: Escape a two-unit police pursuit.
missions.win_condition: Lose both units and clear the search.

missions.title: Evidence Locker
missions.brief: Recover a record before it is destroyed.
missions.win_condition: Secure the record and leave police territory.

missions.title: Silent Witness
missions.brief: Stop a witness from being exposed.
missions.win_condition: Reach the witness first and escort them away.

missions.title: Five Stars
missions.brief: Survive a maximum-level response.
missions.win_condition: Escape the response and reach a designated safehouse.

missions.title: Counter-Surveillance
missions.brief: Detect who is following the team.
missions.win_condition: Identify the tail and break surveillance.

missions.title: Clean Hands
missions.brief: Resolve a crime without increasing the team's wanted level.
missions.win_condition: Complete the objective with no new wanted points.

missions.title: The Broker
missions.brief: Negotiate access to a restricted network.
missions.win_condition: Complete the negotiation and obtain the access token.

missions.title: Three Deliveries
missions.brief: Coordinate three simultaneous deliveries.
missions.win_condition: Complete all three before the network times out.

missions.title: False Friend
missions.brief: Determine which contact is feeding information away.
missions.win_condition: Identify the leak and preserve the relationship you need.

missions.title: Dead Drop
missions.brief: Recover a package from a timed dead drop.
missions.win_condition: Collect the package before the rival team arrives.

missions.title: Switchboard
missions.brief: Trace a sequence of calls.
missions.win_condition: Identify the originating location from the call pattern.

missions.title: The Long Game
missions.brief: Build a lead over several smaller jobs.
missions.win_condition: Complete the linked objectives without failing two in a row.

missions.title: Three Doors
missions.brief: Choose the correct approach to a secure site.
missions.win_condition: Enter using the route matching the evidence you collected.

missions.title: Legitimate Front
missions.brief: Open the team's first legitimate front.
missions.win_condition: Acquire the business and reach operating status.

missions.title: Payroll
missions.brief: Protect employees from a financial squeeze.
missions.win_condition: Resolve the payroll problem and keep the business open.

missions.title: The Property Deal
missions.brief: Acquire a strategic property.
missions.win_condition: Complete the purchase and register ownership.

missions.title: Garage Full
missions.brief: Build a proper vehicle base.
missions.win_condition: Store the required vehicles and unlock the garage tier.

missions.title: Cash Flow
missions.brief: Stabilize the team's finances.
missions.win_condition: End the mission with positive cash flow.

missions.title: Quiet Investor
missions.brief: Find a hidden investor.
missions.win_condition: Meet the investor and secure a conditional investment.

missions.title: Paper Trail
missions.brief: Clean up inconsistencies in the business records.
missions.win_condition: Resolve every flagged transaction.

missions.title: Brother's Photograph
missions.brief: Identify the location in an old photograph.
missions.win_condition: Find the matching location and recover a hidden item.

missions.title: The Safe Voice
missions.brief: Decode a message left for Darius.
missions.win_condition: Decode the message and reach its meeting point.

missions.title: Old Friends
missions.brief: Revisit someone who knew Darius's brother.
missions.win_condition: Get the missing detail without losing the contact.

missions.title: The Inside Room
missions.brief: Enter the hidden room beneath a legitimate business.
missions.win_condition: Find the room and recover the archive.

missions.title: Network Map
missions.brief: Assemble the organization from disconnected evidence.
missions.win_condition: Connect the required nodes in the case board.

missions.title: The Man Behind It
missions.brief: Identify the person directing the operation.
missions.win_condition: Obtain two independent confirmations.

missions.title: Broken Trust
missions.brief: Confront a teammate over a hidden decision.
missions.win_condition: Resolve the confrontation according to your relationship path.

missions.title: Last Preparation
missions.brief: Prepare all three protagonists for the final operation.
missions.win_condition: Complete each protagonist's preparation objective.

missions.title: No Loose Ends
missions.brief: Resolve outstanding threats before the finale.
missions.win_condition: Complete the required cleanup objectives.

missions.title: The Final Route
missions.brief: Choose the safest route into the final site.
missions.win_condition: Reach the site using the route your evidence supports.

missions.title: The Final Ledger
missions.brief: Secure the evidence that can expose 404.
missions.win_condition: Extract the ledger and keep it intact.

missions.title: Three Against The City
missions.brief: Coordinate all three protagonists during the climax.
missions.win_condition: Complete all character objectives and survive.

missions.title: The Last Choice
missions.brief: Make the irreversible final decision.
missions.win_condition: Commit to the selected ending condition.

missions.title: Dawn
missions.brief: Survive the immediate aftermath.
missions.win_condition: Reach the final safe location.

missions.title: Veyron After 404
missions.brief: See what the city becomes after the operation.
missions.win_condition: Complete the final epilogue and unlock free-roam consequences.
